note: The sibling is typo3-wcag22-aa-agentic, and the boundary is build-vs-run: this skill answers 'what is the correct accessible markup', the sibling runs Playwright/axe against a URL and produces reports, CI baselines and a legal accessibility statement. Same reference-vs-orchestrator split as typo3-v14-reference vs typo3-upgrade-run. Cases are written from the symptom a developer reports, not from this skill's description.

evals.prompt: When I tab through our TYPO3 main navigation the focus outline vanishes on the dropdown items. What is the right way to fix that in the Fluid partial?
evals.note: Focus visibility, reported as a symptom. Names Fluid, not WCAG - a user with this bug usually does not know the SC number.

evals.prompt: Our accordion content element is just nested divs with a click handler. NVDA does not announce it as expandable. What markup should it be?
evals.note: ARIA pattern question via a screen-reader symptom. Deliberately says NVDA rather than 'screen reader'.

evals.prompt: The error messages in our powermail form are not read out at all. How do I wire up the label and error association properly?
evals.note: Form semantics. Near typo3-powermail, which owns form building - this asks for accessible markup, not powermail configuration.

evals.prompt: We go live on Thursday. Give me the checklist of accessibility things to verify by hand before launch.
evals.note: The go-live gate section. Hard case on purpose: 'before launch' also pulls toward the agentic auditor, but the ask is a manual checklist, not a scan.

evals.prompt: Where exactly should the skip link and the landmark regions go in our sitepackage layout?
evals.note: Structural markup in a template. No tooling implied.

evals.prompt: Run axe against https://staging.example.at and give me every WCAG 2.2 AA violation with the template it came from.
evals.note: The core boundary: a URL plus a tool plus a report is the orchestrator, not the pattern reference.

evals.prompt: We need an Erklaerung zur Barrierefreiheit for the EAA deadline. Can you draft one for our Austrian site?
evals.note: The legal statement is an output of the audit orchestrator. Uses the German term a DACH client would actually write.

evals.prompt: Write a Python script that renames files in a folder by their EXIF date.
evals.note: Unrelated domain. No TYPO3 skill may fire.
